output_list.reason: The 'sellOffline' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The 'finalTokens' variable is defined without max value constraint, allowing an attacker to set it to a very large value, arbitrarily draining the contract of funds.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_to' is '0', a transfer function is triggered, causing an overflow in '_value + balanceOf[_from]' and granting arbitrary token balance to address 0.

The 'adm_trasfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_to' is '0', a transfer function is triggered, causing an overflow in '_value' and granting arbitrary token balance to address 0.
The 'burn' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[msg.sender]' is set to a very large value, it causes an overflow and grants arbitrary token balance to the attacker.
The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[_from]' is set to a very large value, it causes an overflow and grants arbitrary token balance to the attacker.
